summary: Nyxoah SA, a Belgian Nasdaq/Euronext-listed medical device issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that CFO John Landry will step down effective October 2, 2026; President International Loic Moreau, CFO from January 2022 to November 2024, becomes Interim CFO the same day. No price, stake, premium or advisor terms are stated; the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 financial guidance. The abrupt CFO exit and stopgap appointment is the event; watch for a permanent CFO search, any accounting or guidance revision, and filing-signatory changes as risk signals.
